content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working with [product_name] for the first time and have an 8-input/8-output expansion module. I would like to know if the project software requires hardware configuration similar to other platforms, or if the system recognizes additional modules automatically. Is it possible to connect more 8I/8O expansion modules? We don't see an obvious connector for additional cards. Thank you in advance.
Hi, No hardware configuration is needed. Please refer to the manual (see Chapter 2 for details). Best regards, [user_name]

There is no hardware configuration needed in [product_name]'s software like other platforms. You only need to select the appropriate base module in the device selection menu. Addressing for digital expansion modules is handled automatically. A base module uses addresses for inputs I1 to I8 and outputs Q1 to Q4. For the first digital expansion module: DM8 provides inputs I9 to I12 and outputs Q5 to Q8; DM16 offers inputs I9 to I16 and outputs Q5 to Q12. Each base module can support a maximum of 24 digital inputs, 20 digital outputs, 8 analog inputs, and 8 analog outputs. If more capacity is needed, use additional [product_name] modules and network them. For installation guidance, review the manual, Chapter 2. You can download the manual from [url].
[user_name], your post was very helpful, but one important detail: you cannot mix base modules with 12/24V and 230V expansion modules (or vice versa).

That's not exactly what was asked. Copying the full manual as a response can make posts too lengthy. Additionally, your statement isn't completely accurate: you cannot directly mix 12/24V and 230V devices. However, with 230V base or extension modules, it's possible to use 12/24V extension modules by installing an analog extension module between the 230V and 12/24V modules to provide potential separation. On the other hand, with 12/24V base or expansion modules, inserting an analog module between them and a 230V expansion module does not work.

analysis.insight_summary: Users new to [product_name] are unsure about hardware configuration and expansion detection. There is confusion about whether manual configuration is required, as seen in other platforms, and questions about the ability to add multiple modules. The responses clarify that base modules automatically address expansion modules, without needing additional configuration, but there are important restrictions regarding module mixing based on voltage types, as well as limits on inputs and outputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to recognize new expansion modules automatically or require a simple setup. They also hope to be able to add multiple expansion modules with minimal effort.
